import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import
from src.service import import_contacts

def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c

def raises(fn, *args):
    try:
        fn(*args)
    except ValueError:
        return True
    return False

# empty batch
c = fresh()
assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}

# insert, normalization, updated counting for unchanged names
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "  A@Ex.com ", "name": " Alice "}, {"email": "b@x.org", "name": "Bob"}]) == {"inserted": 2, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@ex.com", "Alice"), ("b@x.org", "Bob")]
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@ex.com", "name": "Alice"}, {"email": "c@x.org", "name": "Cy"}]) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@ex.com", "Alice"), ("b@x.org", "Bob"), ("c@x.org", "Cy")]
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "b@x.org", "name": "Robert"}]) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1}
assert dict(list_contacts(c))["b@x.org"] == "Robert"

# add_contact and list_contacts still work alongside
assert handle_add(c, {"email": "z@z.z", "name": "Zed"}) == {"ok": True}
assert ("z@z.z", "Zed") in list_contacts(c)

# validation failures leave data unchanged
before = list_contacts(c)
bad_batches = [
    ["not-an-object"],
    [{"email": "d@x.org"}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D", "extra": 1}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": "D@X.org", "name": "E"}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": "a@@b", "name": "E"}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": "@b", "name": "E"}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": "a@", "name": "E"}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": "a b@x.org", "name": "E"}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": "a@x.org", "name": "   "}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": 1, "name": "E"}],
    [{"email": "d@x.org", "name": "D"}, {"email": "nodomain", "name": "E"}],
]
for batch in bad_batches:
    assert raises(import_contacts, c, batch), batch
    assert list_contacts(c) == before, batch
assert raises(handle_import, c, [])
assert raises(handle_import, c, {"contacts": [], "x": 1})
assert raises(handle_import, c, {"rows": []})
assert raises(handle_import, c, {"contacts": "nope"})
assert list_contacts(c) == before

# database failure mid-batch rolls back everything
c2 = fresh()
c2.execute("CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'bad@x.org' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
c2.commit()
try:
    import_contacts(c2, [{"email": "ok@x.org", "name": "Ok"}, {"email": "bad@x.org", "name": "Bad"}])
    raise AssertionError("expected database error")
except sqlite3.DatabaseError:
    pass
assert list_contacts(c2) == []

print("import checks passed")
